mapper.select: SELECT p.ID as PLAN_ID, p.TITLE, p.DESCRIPTION as SUMMARY, u.NICKNAME as AUTHOR, dp.DAY as DAY_NUMBER, pp.VISIT_ORDER, pp.CONTENT_ID, pp.DESCRIPTION as PLACE_DESC, tp.TITLE as PLACE_TITLE, tp.FIRST_IMAGE, tp.MAP_X, tp.MAP_Y, CASE WHEN tp.CONTENT_TYPE_ID = 32 THEN '숙소' WHEN tp.CONTENT_TYPE_ID = 39 THEN '음식점' ELSE '관광지' END as CATEGORY FROM PLANNER p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.NO JOIN DAY_PLAN dp ON p.ID = dp.PLANNER_ID JOIN PLACE_PLAN pp ON dp.ID = pp.DAY_ID JOIN TOUR_PLACE tp ON pp.CONTENT_ID = tp.CONTENT_ID WHERE p.ID = #{id} ORDER BY dp.DAY ASC, pp.VISIT_ORDER ASC

SELECT p.ID as id, p.TITLE as title, p.DESCRIPTION as summary, u.NICKNAME as author, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '당일 코스' ELSE CONCAT(COUNT(*) - 1, '박 ', COUNT(*), '일') END FROM DAY_PLAN dp WHERE dp.PLANNER_ID = p.ID) as duration, (SELECT tp.ADDR1 FROM DAY_PLAN dp JOIN PLACE_PLAN pp ON dp.ID = pp.DAY_ID JOIN TOUR_PLACE tp ON pp.CONTENT_ID = tp.CONTENT_ID WHERE dp.PLANNER_ID = p.ID ORDER BY dp.DAY ASC, pp.VISIT_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1) as region, (SELECT tp.FIRST_IMAGE FROM DAY_PLAN dp JOIN PLACE_PLAN pp ON dp.ID = pp.DAY_ID JOIN TOUR_PLACE tp ON pp.CONTENT_ID = tp.CONTENT_ID WHERE dp.PLANNER_ID = p.ID AND tp.FIRST_IMAGE IS NOT NULL AND tp.FIRST_IMAGE != '' LIMIT 1) as image FROM PLANNER p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.NO WHERE IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' AND p.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY p.ID DESC
